name: Microwave Millet Moong Porridge
ingredients: ⅓ cup barnyard or little millet, rinsed
¼ cup split moong dal, rinsed
½ tsp cumin seeds and 1 tsp grated ginger
steps: In a large bowl, microwave the oil, cumin and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the millet, moong dal, vegetables, turmeric, salt and hot water.
Cover loosely and microwave on high for 6 minutes, then at 50% for 12 minutes, stirring once.
Stand covered for 5 minutes until thick and porridge-like.
note: A savoury, easily digested porridge that suits breakfast or a light dinner.
